guides.title: Start a tenant onboarding
guides.blurb: Fill in the tenant form and save it as a quote

steps.title: Company name
steps.text: Type the client's company name - that is all you need to save.

steps.title: Licence key
steps.text: Type a licence key or click Suggest.

steps.title: Main contact
steps.text: The first contact is the main contact: name, surname, email and cell.

steps.title: Save and go on
steps.text: Save & next takes you to Employees, then Modules and the rest. Stop any time with Save & close.

guides.title: Link a clocking device
guides.blurb: Connect a device to a tenant

steps.title: Find the device
steps.text: Type part of the serial number or the device name.

steps.title: Pick the tenant
steps.text: Choose the tenant in the Assigned Tenant column. Dahua devices also need their admin password.

steps.title: Save the link
steps.text: Press Update Link. Any held punches move into the tenant and show on timesheets shortly.
